clips.title: The story
paras: Marshal McBride sends recruits north as kobolds gather at Echo Ridge Mine. The mine supplies ore and raw materials to Northshire Abbey and the Stormwind guard, and the growing threat puts both at risk.

After early skirmishes with scattered vermin around Northshire's forested edge, scouts report a more organized threat. Kobolds have gathered in force at Echo Ridge Mine. Marshal McBride sends you north to face the workers at the entrance and learn how deeply they have settled in.

Echo Ridge Mine supplies ore and raw materials to the Northshire brotherhood and the Stormwind guard stationed there. Kobolds have seized the tunnels, halting extraction and exposing the strain on local defenses. McBride asks you to cull ten workers, but the infestation runs deeper into the shafts than a surface patrol can reach.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought. A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.
Go to the mine and remove them. We know there are at least 10. Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the mines? Are you ready to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
